ideas.pitch: An offline acoustic mesh network using walkie-talkies and audio frequency modulation to transmit emergency transit delay alerts between subway stations without cellular reception.
ideas.title: AcousticMesh Transit Alert
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven hardware and offline communication pattern from ICHack where real radio and mesh implementations stand out dramatically against typical web apps.

ideas.pitch: An offline AI code review assistant running locally on a Raspberry Pi with an attached NPU accelerator to scan Python repositories without internet access.
ideas.title: EdgeNPU Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the offline hardware execution pattern proven at Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon, appealing to judges who value privacy and local inference.

ideas.pitch: A robotic waste sorting bin powered by a live camera feed and a micro-controller that uses a fast local ML classification model to sort recyclables instantly.
ideas.title: SmartBin Vision Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the robotics and edge-AI computer vision pattern that won awards at TechnoMorph Hackathon by delivering an engaging live physical demo.

ideas.pitch: A small autonomous rover equipped with ultrasonic sensors and SLAM mapping to navigate indoor hallways and deliver small items between campus labs.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the physical autonomous robotics winning strategy seen at International Hackathon Quanta, which always captivates judges during live judging walk-throughs.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight edge defense monitor that detects unauthorized drone radio frequencies and triggers a deterministic mechanical lockdown gate without relying on cloud connectivity.
ideas.title: EdgeJam Counter-UAS Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the robust edge-resilience and deterministic fail-safe engineering pattern that secured wins at the AWS Global Government Hackathon.
